author: ETA PRIME
description:
We take a hands-on look at the all-new Minisforum EliteMini M2 Air 304! Coming in at just $263 for the barebones model, this could be the ultimate budget mini PC. Powered by Intel’s new Core 3 304 processor with an Intel Arc iGPU, we push this tiny machine to the limit. From 4K video playback and everyday web browsing to emulation and surprisingly capable PC gaming with XeSS Frame Gen, this ultra-efficient PC packs a serious punch for the price.
